values.note: $16 a night per single site, reservable or walk-up; $5 extra-vehicle fee if a second vehicle stays at the site longer than 30 minutes (or move it to the overflow parking area).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/north-dickey-lake-campground ('Single Site: $16 per night', last updated April 30, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233778/rates (2026 Peak Season and First-come, First-served Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $16) + rec.gov notice ('you will need to pay the $5 extra vehicle fee or move the vehicle to the Overflow Parking Area'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/north-dickey-lake-campground ('50% discount with US Golden Age/Access or Interagency Senior/Access Passes'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/north-dickey-lake-campground ('utility hookups are not available') + rec.gov per-site catalog (all 24 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, no water/sewer attribute), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 23 tent/RV sites plus a camp-host site (recreation.gov lists 24). Per-site max vehicle lengths on recreation.gov: 40 ft at 20 sites, 50 ft at 2, 30 ft at 2. Gravel parking surfaces.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/north-dickey-lake-campground ('The campground offers 23 sites for tent and RV camping', 'Parking surfaces are gravel') + rec.gov per-site catalog (24 sites incl. 'Camphost Site' 7; max vehicle length 30 ft x2, 40 ft x20, 50 ft x2), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/north-dickey-lake-campground and https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233778 (both: 'Accessible vault toilets and drinking water are provided'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Recreation.gov says only five sites can be reserved, the rest first-come, first-served, but its own site catalog marks 13 of the 24 as reservable. Saving a first-come site is prohibited. 16-day stay limit; check-in/out 2 pm.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233778 ('only five (5) sites can be reserved. The rest are available on a first-come, first-served basis'; notices '16 Day Stay limit', 'Check-in/out 2:00 pm', 'Non-reservable sites area first come-first serve. Saving site is prohibited.'; rule maxConsecutiveStay 16) + rec.gov per-site catalog (13 sites reservable) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/north-dickey-lake-campground ('only some of the sites can be reserved'), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS campground on a hillside next to 800-acre Dickey Lake (Kootenai NF, Rexford/Fortine RD), just off US-93 a little over a mile south of Fortine, in larch and fir at ~3,100 ft. Boating, fishing (kokanee, kamloops, rainbow trout), swimming and water skiing; the grassy swimming beach is at South Dickey Day Use Area across the lake. The accessible half-mile Dickey Lake Overlook Trail and a trail to Mt. Marston start nearby. Nearest dump station: just north of Eureka on US-93, behind a gas station. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page + recreation.gov: confirmed $16 single site, no hookups, vault toilets and drinking water, partly reservable on rec.gov / rest FCFS, 50-ft max (rec.gov catalog), and the inherited Senior/Access 50% discount. Changed site count 24 -> 23 (FS: 23 sites; rec.gov's 24th is the camp host), added the 16-day stay limit and the $5 extra-vehicle fee. Not stated: season (FS 'Seasons of Use' shows only 'May'), booking window. No alert affects the campground or US-93. Note trimmed of restated values.
